tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs (import, installer, license).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, store cards and list rows on `bg`.

tokens.name: card-hover
tokens.usage: Card fill while hovered; pressed secondary button.

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, icon tiles, inputs, cover placeholders, the gauge track.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around panels, cards, buttons and sheets.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger outline: the game-page cover, focus-adjacent edges.

tokens.name: hover-ring
tokens.usage: 1px outline on a hovered cover or tile (replaces the hairline).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles and body copy on `bg`, `card`, `elevated` (14:1 and up).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, help text and metadata on `bg`, `card`, `elevated` (6:1 and up).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Footnotes, timestamps, placeholder icons. 3.7:1 on `card`: below 4.5:1, so only for 12px secondary notes or 24px+ text; kept as in the app.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The only hue in the chrome: selection, toggles, links, progress. 5.6:1 on `card`.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button on a screen (Play, Add to Library).

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `cta` (17.8:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Connected, finished, positive factors, Excellent tier. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Known issues, Playable tier, negative factors. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Stop, uninstall, blockers, Won't-run tier. White text on it is 3.4:1 (kept from the app): use it only for 13px+ semibold labels.

tokens.name: favorite
tokens.usage: Heart on favorited games only.

tokens.name: tier-good
tokens.usage: Good compatibility tier (badge, gauge ring). Label always beside it.

tokens.name: tier-poor
tokens.usage: Poor compatibility tier (badge, gauge ring). Label always beside it.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Game title on the game page.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section labels and panel headings, sentence case.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Game names under covers and in tiles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, help text under controls, footnotes.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Windows paths, file names, launch options, score impacts (+12).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons in a row, inside badges, list row spacing.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps inside panels.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Grid gutters, gaps between panels, primary button side padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Page content inset from the window edges and sidebar; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small thumbnails, cover in the installer chooser.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, covers, inputs, rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, store cards, wide tiles, banners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and compatibility badges (capsules).

shadow.note: SwiftUI shadows translated to CSS (blur = 2 × SwiftUI radius).

tokens.name: shadow-cover-hover
tokens.usage: A library cover while hovered (with a 1.02 scale).

tokens.name: shadow-cover-hero
tokens.usage: The cover overlapping the artwork band on the game page.

tokens.name: shadow-play
tokens.usage: The round play button that appears on a hovered cover.
